tasks.example:build: deno task example:version && deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build --root example/src --entry main.ts --outdir example/dist --strict --minify
tasks.example:dev: deno task example:version && deno run -A jsr:@marianmeres/deno-build --root example/src --entry main.ts --outdir example/dist --watch --watch-dir example/src
tasks.npm:publish: deno run -A scripts/build-npm.ts && cd ./.npm-dist && npm publish --access=public
tasks.rp: deno task release -y && deno task publish
tasks.rpm: deno task release minor -y && deno task publish
